verdict.rationale: The Cloud API documentation lists pairing multiple Solo card readers to an account and naming each reader, which covers basic device registration and light labeling. It also supports driving transactions on multiple readers at once, with Virtual Solo available for testing pairing. However, there is no evidence of device status monitoring or remote configuration management, and webhooks cover only checkout status changes. Missing for 10: reader status/health monitoring API, remote configuration updates beyond naming, support for Go readers and other device types in fleet management, fleet-level device listing/management endpoints, independent corroboration.
